title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Tomdever wpForo…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the wpForo Forum plugin by Tomdever, affecting versions up to and including 3.2.4. This vulnerability allows attackers to inject malicious scripts that are stored and executed when users view affected pages. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.1.
